templates.name: Public facts
templates.cypher:
MATCH p=(a)-[r]->(b)
WHERE type(r) <> 'MERGED_WITH'
  AND r.acl_ref IS NULL
RETURN p
LIMIT 100

templates.name: ACL-scoped facts
templates.cypher:
MATCH p=(a)-[r]->(b)
WHERE type(r) <> 'MERGED_WITH'
  AND r.acl_ref IS NOT NULL
RETURN p
LIMIT 100

templates.name: Active facts
templates.cypher:
MATCH p=(a)-[r]->(b)
WHERE type(r) <> 'MERGED_WITH'
  AND r.t_invalid IS NULL
RETURN p
LIMIT 100

templates.name: Closed historical facts
templates.cypher:
MATCH p=(a)-[r]->(b)
WHERE type(r) <> 'MERGED_WITH'
  AND r.t_invalid IS NOT NULL
RETURN p
LIMIT 100
